title: La tercera persona impersonal y el indefinido uno
goal: Master third-person plural impersonals and indefinite 'uno' to obscure agency and formulate shared human principles.
grammar: tercera persona plural impersonal y pronombre indefinido uno

items: Deploy plural third-person verbs without explicit subject to communicate rumors or general talk.
Utilize indefinite 'uno' to project generalized experience in thoughtful discourse.
Avoid conversational 'uno' in strict academic prose favoring nominalizations.
